items.title: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Reports Stronger Survival Data In EGFR Mutated Lung Cancer
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) reported new clinical trial results for RYBREVANT-based regimens in EGFR-mutated NSCLC at a major oncology conference. The Phase 2b COPERNICUS study showed RYBREVANT plus LAZCLUZE for newly diagnosed patients with EGFR-mutated NSCLC had improved tolerability and fewer treatment-related adverse events.
